Sales Representative Job at Baykins Pharmaceutical Company




        
    

        
        Baykins Pharmaceutical Company is a fast-growing healthcare organization committed to improving lives through the distribution and delivery of quality pharmaceutical products and healthcare solutions. We are dedicated to operational excellence, innovation, and providing exceptional service to our customers while fostering a supportive and professional work environment for our employees.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Representative 

Job Location: Oniru, Lagos Island - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an energetic and results-driven Sales Representative to promote and sell the company's products, build strong customer relationships, and drive business growth. The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication, negotiation, and customer service skills.


Key Responsibilities


	Promote and sell the company's products to existing and prospective customers.
	Identify and develop new business opportunities.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
	Meet and exceed assigned sales targets.
	Prepare and submit sales reports.
	Monitor market trends and competitor activities.
	Follow up on customer inquiries and resolve complaints promptly.
	Represent the company professionally during customer engagements.


Requirements


	Minimum of OND, HND, or Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
	At least 1 year of sales experience is an added advantage.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Strong negotiation and persuasive selling skills.
	Ability to meet sales targets and work independently.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.


Salary
N100,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Application for Sales Representative" as the subject of the email.

Note: For more enquiries, WhatsApp 0913 343 5058.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Procurement Officer",
  "description": "Egbin Power Plc. Lagos is one of the biggest additions to the electricity industry in Nigeria. Often seen as the biggest single generating power station in Sub-Saharan Africa, it was built to meet the every rising demand for electricity in Lagos and its environs.

Following the nation&rsquo;s privatization exercise, Sahara, through its power division, Sahara Power Group and sundry affiliations, acquired the 1320 MW installed capacity Egbin Power Plant. We are working towards deploying a minimum of 5,000 MW of electricity generation over the next five years.&nbsp;

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Procurement Officer

Job Identification: 615
Job Location: Nigeria

Job Summary


	This role will be responsible for ensuring the timely and cost-effective sourcing of critical tools, spare parts, equipment, and operational materials across the plant. The position will also leverage digital procurement solutions, market intelligence, and data analytics to drive informed decision-making, operational efficiency, and sustainable value creation.


Key Duties and Responsibilities


	Estimate and establish cost parameters and budgets for purchases
	Develop and maintain good relationships with vendors/suppliers
	Review and analyse all vendors/suppliers and their price options
	Negotiate the best deal for pricing and supply contracts
	Ensure that purchased goods and supplies are of high quality
	Responsible for issuing requests for quotations for all major equipment and services supplies.
	Prepare technical and financial comparison sheets for different tenders for major or expensive equipment.

Procurement Officer Job at Egbin Power Plc




        
    

        
        Egbin Power Plc. Lagos is one of the biggest additions to the electricity industry in Nigeria. Often seen as the biggest single generating power station in Sub-Saharan Africa, it was built to meet the every rising demand for electricity in Lagos and its environs.

Following the nation’s privatization exercise, Sahara, through its power division, Sahara Power Group and sundry affiliations, acquired the 1320 MW installed capacity Egbin Power Plant. We are working towards deploying a minimum of 5,000 MW of electricity generation over the next five years. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Procurement Officer

Job Identification: 615
Job Location: Nigeria
     

            
    



Job Summary


	This role will be responsible for ensuring the timely and cost-effective sourcing of critical tools, spare parts, equipment, and operational materials across the plant. The position will also leverage digital procurement solutions, market intelligence, and data analytics to drive informed decision-making, operational efficiency, and sustainable value creation.


Key Duties and Responsibilities


	Estimate and establish cost parameters and budgets for purchases
	Develop and maintain good relationships with vendors/suppliers
	Review and analyse all vendors/suppliers and their price options
	Negotiate the best deal for pricing and supply contracts
	Ensure that purchased goods and supplies are of high quality
	Responsible for issuing requests for quotations for all major equipment and services supplies.
	Prepare technical and financial comparison sheets for different tenders for major or expensive equipment.
	Ensure follow-up of all client instructions and agreements according to prices and conditions for the delivery time of all purchased material
	Inspection of all incoming goods upon arrival for compliance
	To check for approval of all incoming invoices for equipment and services
	Develop and maintain an up-to-date library of suppliers and products and services catalogues.
	Ensure availability of the right quality and quantity of the material required in the plant
	Optimize procurement lead time and cost of materials procured within the guideline and control parameters 
	Monitor vendors to ensure contractual obligations are timely met
	Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to prevent non mechanical and mechanical materials from being out of stock
	Implement data protection policies and practices of Egbin Power Plc.
	Ensure compliance with the NDPR and other data protection laws and data protection policies.
	Undertake Data Protection Impact Assessment as applicable to curb the risk during data processing operations.
	Ensure awareness of the integrated management system (ISO 9001:2015, 14001:2015 & 45001:2018) and the implications of not confirming with the requirement 
	Understand and identify hazards, risks, environmental aspects and Impacts as it is related to their jobs.


Education and Work Experience  

Employeebackground checks


	Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical Maintenance & Instrumentation and Control engineering) or any other relevant degree with 3 years’ experience as an Engineer or a Technical Procurement Officer or any related role. 
	Knowledge of supply chain or any relevant field will be an added advantage.


Skills and Competencies:


	Experience in leveraging digital and data analytics tools like Power BI and Excel to drive efficiencies.
	Proficiency in the use of other Microsoft Office tools.
	Good verbal and written communication skills
	Ability to multitask, prioritize and manage time efficiently.
	Accurate and precise attention to detail.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "IT Specialist",
  "description": "At UUL Global, we specialize in delivering time-sensitive, complex, and high-value solutions tailored to your unique logistics needs. As a leader in the industry, we pride ourselves on our commitment to excellence and our ability to provide comprehensive logistics and transportation services that cater to businesses of all sizes. Our Mission We seek to provide exceptional service and tailored solutions for our clients&#39; global logistics and supply chain needs.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: IT Specialist&nbsp;

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	UUL United Logistics Nigeria Limited is looking for a hands-on and solution-oriented IT Support Officer to join our team.
	The successful candidate will serve as the first line of IT support, providing day-to-day technical assistance to employees while supporting our office network, CCTV systems, user accounts, information&nbsp;security controls, and IT automation.


Key Responsibilities
Employee ID &amp; Account Provisioning:


	Produce and manage employee ID badges.
	Handle mailbox applications, configuration, and permissions.
	Maintain accurate account and permission registers.


Office Network &amp; CCTV Operations:


	Operate and maintain LAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, and printers.
	Monitor and maintain CCTV systems, ensuring coverage and storage integrity.
	Liaise with ISPs and vendors for faults and repairs.
	Maintain IT asset registers and consumables stock.


Employee Device &amp; Application Support:


	Provide first-line support for hardware, OS, office software, and printing.
	Install, configure, and update systems and applications.
	Perform basic hardware diagnosis and repairs.
	Create simple how-to guides for recurring issues.


Automation with Python:


	Develop scripts to automate repetitive IT/HR tasks (e.g., badge generation, asset reporting, ticket statistics).
	Document scripts and lodge with HRD.
	Identify further automation opportunities.


Information Security:&nbsp;

SecurityProducts &amp; Services
